messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Implemented named saves and more flexible snapshot imports.

- Added a **Deal name** field. Names are preserved in version 2 snapshots; unnamed saves remain version 1. Names clear on new deals, restarts, size changes, board loads, and version 1 imports. See [Reproduction.tsx](/work/src/game/controls/Reproduction.tsx:39) and [use-game.ts](/work/src/game/session/use-game.ts:72).
- Snapshot imports now accept fields in any JSON property order while still validating the exact fields and saved progress. See [snapshot.ts](/work/src/game/snapshot.ts:39).

Verification passed: locked install, 142 unit tests, build and typecheck, and all 78 browser journeys on the named runtime. Changed files pass Prettier. The workspace-wide format check flags 23 existing files outside this change.
